changes: Management report aggregates share a repeatable-read, read-only database transaction instead of six independent pool snapshots.
Average order amount is rounded to two decimal places in SQL; cancelled and fully returned orders remain excluded from its denominator.
The panel validates response dates, currency, counts, money, daily coverage, exact-cent aggregate totals and cash arithmetic before rendering or exporting.
Malformed successful responses fail only their report section; successful independent sales or operations sections remain usable.
Report generation time is visible and exported in Istanbul time. Numeric Excel amounts and snapshot-bound navigation/export are preserved.
The channel report is labelled as sales channels, all working catalogue links remain mapped, and the unavailable visitor-analytics placeholder is removed.

verification.isolated_sql: verify-management-report.cjs passed actual report SQL, repeatable-read/read-only settings, transaction-mode reset, partial/full returns, archive exclusion, currency separation, director privacy, half-cent rounding and zero reports; actual client validator accepted the returned contracts.
verification.handlers: verify-report-read-isolation.cjs passed malformed response, arithmetic mismatch, missing dates, invalid filters, independent failures and stale-response scenarios.
verification.exports: verify-report-export-selection.cjs passed matching-period guards, numeric amounts, currency and Istanbul generation metadata.
verification.markup: verify-management-report-view.cjs passed working catalogue routes, labelled tables, generation time, error and changed-filter views. This is server-rendered markup, not browser visual verification.
verification.admin_build: management-snapshot-admin-build-20261122-evening.log passed compilation, types and all 53 static pages. The later catalogue-only removal was checked by actual page render; the final window build will include it.

rollout: Deploy API before panel; the validated summary contract requires generatedAt and two-decimal average_order. No new migration.
limitations: No separate production PostgreSQL connections were used to simulate concurrent writers; transaction isolation was verified with isolated PGlite SQL.
Live report totals and browser layout remain unverified.
